llamaImport.description: Importa un file di modello GGUF per aggiungerlo alla tua raccolta. Attiva il supporto multimodale per allegare un mmproj (input di immagini o audio) o il supporto ai modelli draft per la decodifica speculativa. I modelli di embedding vengono rilevati automaticamente.

llamaImport.clipModel: This model has CLIP architecture and cannot be imported as a text generation model. CLIP models are designed for vision tasks and require different handling.

llamaImport.draftClip: This file has CLIP architecture and cannot be used as a draft model.

llamaImport.multimodalHint: Enable if your model uses an mmproj for image or audio input. Modalities are detected from the projector file.
llamaImport.draftHint: Attach a smaller draft model (including MTP draft heads) for speculative decoding. The draft model must share the main model's tokenizer and vocabulary.
llamaImport.embeddingHint: This model will be imported for embeddings only. Multimodal options are disabled.
